title: Bare Bones x Table Top Craft
description: Bare Bones textures for Table Top Craft mod ! ♟️
body:
This resource pack will make [Table Top Craft](https://modrinth.com/mod/table-top-craft) compatible with Bare Bones style !

- I highly recommend using [Bare Bones x Mods](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/bare-bones-x-mods) instead of this pack - It's a more convenient way to use my Bare Bones compatibility packs !
